Built on Solana for speed, low fees, and viral potential, $TROLLER is designed to become more than just another meme token. It’s a movement powered by community culture, livestreams, raids, memes, and pure internet insanity.

This isn’t a smooth train ride.
This is the wildest ride in crypto.

🎢 Hold on tight.
🎭 Embrace the chaos.
🚀 Enjoy the ride.

Troller Coaster ($TROLLER)
No brakes. Only momentum.

candidates.name: Bird Dogs Pizza
candidates.description:
Inspired By Matt Furie
While Pepe is lounging at the lake and Brett is at the gym, Bird Dog is grinding. He’s the original pizza delivery guy of the Boy's Club, clocking in long hours to keep the fridge full. But Bird Dog has a secret: every time he "delivers" a pump to the community, he’s skimming a slice off the top to feed the stray dogs in the neighborhood.
He’s tired, he’s overworked, but he’s got a heart of gold. He’s not just delivering pizza; he’s delivering a future for pups in need.
